name: cut-samples
setup: python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; t = open('/content/.hf_token').read().strip(); [snapshot_download(r, repo_type='dataset', cache_dir='/content/hf/hub', token=t, max_workers=8) for r in ['calfa-ai/AMIDDA']]"

runs.label: cut
runs.cmd: cd /content/work/tadqiq && TADQIQ_HUB=/content/hf/hub PYTHONPATH=src python -u scripts/cut_samples.py /content/work/want.json /content/crnn_out/samples --only AMIDDA
